status.en: 22 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Baghdad, Maysan and Kirkuk.
status.nb: 22 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Baghdad, Maysan og Kirkuk.

summary.en: 25 armed incidents were reported in the past seven days, mainly in Baghdad, Maysan and Kirkuk, and none were carried by more than one outlet. The UCDP recorded 396 battle‑related deaths in 2024. Tensions are rising in Iraqi Kurdistan as Iran continues strikes against Kurdish forces, while the US and Iraq discuss post‑coalition ties and the dinar exchange rate. ISIS is exploiting security gaps after the coalition withdrawal, with renewed attacks in Hawija, and Iranian drones have struck a Kurdish organization’s base near Erbil. The Iraqi prime minister is set to embark on a Gulf tour, and Kurdish leaders are weighing the impacts of the US withdrawal.
summary.nb: 25 væpnede hendelser ble rapportert de siste syv dagene, hovedsakelig i Bagdad, Maysan og Kirkuk, og ingen ble dekket av mer enn ett medie. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024. Spenningene øker i irakisk Kurdistan ettersom Iran fortsetter angrep mot kurdiske styrker, mens USA og Irak diskuterer post‑koalisjonsforbindelser og valutakursen for dinaren. ISIS utnytter sikkerhetshull etter koalisjonsavtrekkingen, med nye angrep i Hawija, og iranske droner har truffet en kurdisk organisasjons base nær Erbil. Iraks statsminister skal på Gulf‑tur, og kurdiske ledere vurderer konsekvensene av USAs tilbaketrekning.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
